blocks.text: Illness field guide — complete collection

This is the complete illustrated collection in your logbook. Highlight any definition, add notes and tags, mark it read, and use Save or Backups as you do for other readings. Each individual card also has its own reading for focused notes. Collection notes and individual-card notes are stored separately.

Reply Echo
stress · Location trademark
Deleted replies recur in the pet’s signal, mirroring the board’s reconstructed messages.
Location: Cacheboard, the Unintended Board

Appearance: Afterimages keep floating outward. Periodically the main pet disappears while six copies scatter for 0.85 seconds, return in 0.18 seconds, and merge back. Events recur every 10, 6, or 3.8 seconds by severity; reduced motion never hides the pet.
Care: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
Story connection: A reply fragment could lead to a contributor whose record was erased.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Established Era −3 location. Production details are an expanded reconstruction.

Mild / moderate / severe: scatter-and-return events recur every 10 / 6 / 3.8 seconds. Return is faster than departure.

Care: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.

chronic · Location trademark
The missing partitions leave the pet’s outline briefly searching for a room that is gone.
Location: Shelter Orison, the Vanishing Shelter

Appearance: Opaque Blue Cap and Meep visitors emerge through a temporary door at the pet, linger nearby, and disappear through a separate exit door. Care: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
Story connection: A future rescue could distinguish shelter memories from navigable rooms.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Story-established. Its internal geography is only partly recoverable.

Tide Repeat
stress · Location trademark
A wave that has already passed leaves a second outline behind the pet.
Location: The Repeated Beach

Appearance: Broad filled water ribbons roll in a pronounced up-and-down wave across the feet, and the actual character distorts vertically with the same wavelength, direction and four-second clock. A second crest follows behind with pale foam marks. Wave and body amplitude increase with severity; reduced motion freezes both together.
Care: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
Story connection: The repeated tide could expose a message absent from the first shoreline.

New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed game-background location derived from recurrence, Last Loops, and the game interface’s translation of deeper processes.

infection · Location trademark

Doorwake Drift
stress · Location trademark
Competing shore doors pull the pet’s outline toward incompatible destinations.
Location: The Inland Sea of Doors

Appearance: Two linked doors trap the character in a continuous walking loop. As its actual pixels enter one doorway, they emerge from the opposite doorway, with an alternating foot stride and no full-body disappearance. Gameplay position, size and action stay unchanged. Mild, moderate and severe loops last 8, 6 and 4 seconds; reduced motion freezes the crossing.
Care: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
Story connection: A future door survey could identify a shore that has not yet been mapped.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

Season-Turn Churn
digestive · Location trademark
Broken seasons impose mismatched growth and rest rhythms on digestion.
Location: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons

Appearance: Seasons pass through the actual body in the wrong order: sprouts grow from the skin, frost spreads over them, autumn leaves dry and tumble away, and summer husks shed grains. Each transition fades smoothly before the next begins.
Care: Use the digestive treatment listed in Care and sensible portions.
Story connection: A communal harvest could reconnect adjoining seasonal plots.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
